visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a large, plush yellow cat statue wearing a black hat, positioned at the center of an exhibition booth under a sign reading 'Fumeancats'. The background features festive banners and shelves filled with merchandise. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of shelves stocked with yellow cat-shaped plush pouches wrapped in plastic. (3) A hand is seen holding and demonstrating a black cat-shaped pouch with yellow eyes. (4) Hands flip through a yellow plush card collector book, showing plastic sleeves inside for holding cards. (5) A spinning metal badge featuring a cat character eating noodles is shown, with a finger physically spinning the inner wheel. (6) A display board shows various colorful round keychains with cat illustrations. (7) Several cat-themed fabric amulets (Omamori) hang on a display, followed by a yellow drink carrier bag featuring a cat with a grumpy expression. (8) A wall of various cat plushies is shown, including long, cylindrical 'catnip' plush toys. (9) The camera moves to boxes of catnip balls and round coasters with cat illustrations. (10) A white cat-shaped towel is held and unfolded to show its shape. (11) Small, round cat plush keychains are shown in a basket. (12) The scene shifts to another booth section for 'Chubby OJISAN', showing various stickers and character goods. (13) Another booth area for 'Lazynfatty' is displayed, featuring pig and animal plushies in pink and white. (14) A large wall graphic providing a character profile for 'AMA' (a cat character) is shown, followed by a wide shot of the entire booth featuring a wall of cat graphics and the exhibition location information.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional highlight reel for the 'Fumeancats' exhibition booth at the Creative Expo Taiwan. It aims to showcase the wide variety of cat-themed merchandise available—including plushies, stationery, and home goods—while also cross-promoting partner character booths like 'Chubby OJISAN' and 'Lazynfatty' to attract visitors to the physical event venue.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video provides specific location details, exhibition booth numbers, and dates to encourage viewers to visit and purchase the showcased products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high text density and rapid montage editing typical of short-form social media promotion to maximize product exposure in a short timeframe.
